verdict.rationale: Pilot advertises an in-portal AI chat that gives 'instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow' and can tell you if you 'can afford new hires,' which matches the affordability-question use case (pilot-docs-7, pilot-docs-8, pilot-docs-21). However, there is no evidence this is accessible via an API for an external agent — probes for OpenAPI/swagger specs all returned 404, indicating no documented public API for ledger data access. missing for 10: documented public API/OpenAPI spec for ledger data, evidence of third-party/agent API integration, confirmation the AI Q&A pulls 'live' data rather than periodic syncs.
